name: Archer Daniels Midland
outlook:
What Archer Daniels Midland says to expect

  • Full year 2026: adjusted EPSADM now expects 2026 adjusted EPS 1,2 of approximately $5.50 to $5.80, up from the prior adjusted EPS guidance range of $5.15 to $5.60
  • Full year 2026: capital expendituresCapital expenditures now projected to be in the range of $1.2 to $1.3 billion, revised from the prior range of $1.3 to $1.5 billion, reflecting the company’s continued prioritization of high-return investments
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 3, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
